notes: New: Copy settings between TVs. In Customize > Manage, send this TV's look, dock order, wallpapers, screen saver, remote buttons and speed options to another HomeZ TV in your home, with a 6-digit code. The TVs talk directly and encrypted, nothing leaves your home, and Undo the last copy puts things back. A new TV's setup offers it too, and lists the apps the other TV has. About HomeZ is now called Manage. Setup now asks whether to optimize the TV, and skips the ad-blocking question when it's already on. Fixed a photo with the same name as another one not showing.
